# Artistry at Nassau County Museum of Art

> Artistry is an event venue inside Nassau County Museum of Art in Roslyn, NY, on Long Island's North Shore. It hosts weddings, corporate events, social celebrations and celebrations of life across eight indoor and outdoor spaces, for up to 800 guests. Artistry is operated by FIDI Hospitality, and Tardi's Catering is its exclusive caterer.

## Contact

- Address: Nassau County Museum of Art, One Museum Dr, Roslyn, NY 11576
- Phone: 212.971.5353
- Email: info@eventsatartistry.com
- Book a tour or request pricing: https://www.eventsatartistry.com/#contact
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eventsatartistry
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/eventsatartistry

## Event spaces and capacity

- Great Lawn: up to 800 guests, outdoor, tented events with custom tenting, flooring and lighting
- Formal Garden: up to 500 guests, outdoor English garden with a historic trellis, seats 200
- East Terrace: up to 250 guests, open-air terrace with pond and sculpture garden views
- North Terrace: up to 250 guests, open-air terrace within the sculpture garden
- Tented Pavilion: up to 125 guests, glass-walled pavilion with direct access to the mansion's galleries
- Collection Gallery: up to 100 guests, art gallery on the mansion's second floor, seats 80 lecture style
- Gazebo: up to 50 guests, open-air gazebo for intimate ceremonies, photos and cocktails
- Formal Library: up to 40 guests, the Frick Estate Library, seats 40 for a luncheon or dinner, 60 standing

## Event types

- Weddings: ceremony packages (50 or 100 chairs, sound system, audio technician, microphone, aisle runner) and four reception packages, each with a 1-hour cocktail reception, 4-hour reception and 5-hour bar. 50 guest minimum for reception packages.
- Corporate events: meetings and conferences (10 to 200 guests), corporate dinners (10 to 150), cocktail receptions (50 to 400), awards and presentations (100 to 500), summer BBQs and outdoor outings (50 to 300). A/V, stage and lighting available.
- Social events: Bar and Bat Mitzvahs, Communions, Confirmations and milestone celebrations, with custom décor and kosher-friendly menu options. Four packages, 50 guest minimum.
- Celebrations of life and memorial gatherings: for 20 guests or 200, with one coordinator throughout. Four packages, 50 guest minimum.

## Catering and pricing

- Tardi's Catering is the exclusive caterer. Menus are custom, with plated dinners, buffets, small plates and food stations. Vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free selections are available.
- Every reception package includes a 5-hour bar: beer and wine in Package One, a full spirits bar in Packages Two to Four.
- Packages are priced per person and quoted on request. The venue rental fee is separate, and a 24% service charge and New York State sales tax are added.
- Tardi's Cafe on the museum grounds serves coffee, light fare and pastries, Tuesday to Sunday 10am to 4pm, closed Mondays.

## Getting here

- By car: off Northern Blvd (Route 25A) in Roslyn, about 30 minutes from Manhattan. Ample free parking on site.
- By train: LIRR Port Washington Branch to Roslyn Station, then a short taxi or rideshare ride.
